# simply_dns_record (Resource)

Manages a DNS record in a Simply.com product DNS zone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "simply_dns_record" "www" {
  product = "example.com"
  name    = "www"
  type    = "CNAME"
  data    = "web.example.net"
  ttl     = 3600
  comment = "Example web alias"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `data` (String) DNS record data.
- `name` (String) Record name within the DNS zone.
- `product` (String) Simply.com product object, usually the domain name.
- `type` (String) DNS record type.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Optional record comment.
- `priority` (Number) Priority value for record types such as MX and SRV.
- `ttl` (Number) Record TTL in seconds.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform resource ID in the form `product:record_id`.
- `record_id` (Number) Simply.com DNS record ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import simply_dns_record.www example.com:123456
```
